response.overview: A heartwarming and imaginative stop-motion puppet animation that explores childhood perspective and processing grief. The story centers on a young boy who struggles to cope with the profound sadness of losing his beloved pet dog. In his immense grief, he finds comfort by completely immersing himself in a whimsical world of his own imagination, trying to preserve his memories of his companion. Through a magical blend of childhood innocence and deep emotion, the film beautifully captures the delicate process of saying goodbye and finding healing.
response.title: 蕃茄醬
